name: Hypatia
tagline: Scan your phone for malware in real time
description:
Hypatia keeps an eye on your Android phone for malware, scanning apps and files as they arrive so threats get caught early instead of after the damage is done. It's a fork of the well-regarded DivestOS malware scanner, continuing that project's work of offering everyday people a free and open way to protect their phones.

It runs quietly in the background, giving you an extra layer of defense without needing a paid antivirus subscription.
